name: Honcho
ontology_notes: SQLAlchemy tables Workspace, Peer, Session, Message, Collection(observer, observed), Document with DocumentLevel explicit|deductive|inductive|contradiction, plus session summaries and peer cards (list[str] biographical facts, max 40). Not typed companion kinds such as character autobiography, relationship state, lore, or OOC. Peers can be users, agents, or NPCs.

ontology.evidence: src/models.py defines Workspace, Peer, Session, Message, Collection(observer, observed), Document.level DocumentLevel=explicit|deductive|inductive|contradiction (src/utils/types.py). Peer cards are list[str] biographical facts (honcho.dev/docs/v3/documentation/features/advanced/peer-card.md). No tables for character lore, relationship state, or OOC.
ontology.label: measured

write_policy.evidence: Write path is synchronous message insert plus enqueue (architecture.md). Deriver extracts explicit and deductive conclusions per message; Dreamer consolidates and writes inductive conclusions and peer-card facts; Create Conclusions and peer.set_card are manual. observe_me=false skips derivation for a peer. Messages themselves are not filtered for jokes or hypotheticals.
write_policy.label: measured

read_policy.evidence: session.context() injects summary plus recent messages (40/60 token split) and optional peer_representation/peer_card when peer_target is set (get-context.md). peer.chat() and honcho.chat() spawn a Dialectic agent that searches conclusions and may return content=null when nothing relevant is found. Search can be scoped by session, scope, or semantic top_k.
read_policy.label: measured

supersession.evidence: Dreaming deduction specialist deletes outdated conclusions when a fact changes (for example works at A then B) and resolves contradictions (dreaming.md). Session delete removes explicit session-tied conclusions but derived workspace-level conclusions survive (deleting-data.md). No user-facing retcon vs lie vs narrator types.
supersession.label: measured

temporal.evidence: Messages and Documents have created_at. Summaries fire every 20 (short) and 60 (long) messages. Scopes and session allowlists bound recall by provenance. LoCoMo temporal category is scored at 77.1% on their blog. No first-class validity windows or last-Tuesday query type.
temporal.label: inferred

identity_split.evidence: Peers are first-class. Collections are unique on (observer, observed, workspace_name) in src/models.py Collection. Directional representations and directional peer cards via target= (directional-representations.md, peer-card.md). Sessions group multi-peer chats. This can model user vs character as two peers.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: Peer cards may include INSTRUCTION strings such as Never mention her ex-boyfriend (peer-card.md). Scopes bound recall by session membership, not by topic (scopes.md Provenance, Not Topic). No trauma/kink/spoiler filter on embedding rank.
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: Messages are stored and reasoned over without provenance trust tags. SECURITY.md exists for the product, not for stored-text jailbreaks. Derived conclusions can outlive the session that produced them (deleting-data.md), so a poisoned write can persist after session delete.
poisoning.label: measured

forgetting.evidence: DELETE conclusion is immediate 204. Session delete cascades messages and explicit conclusions asynchronously. Peers and individual messages cannot be deleted (deleting-data.md). No user forget-that API that also retracts derived conclusions automatically.
forgetting.label: measured

cost_shape.evidence: Write does not wait on an LLM. Deriver plus summarizer run per message. Dreamer runs after 50 new conclusions, 8h cooldown, 60min idle (dreaming.md). Dialectic chat is an inline tool-loop with reasoning_level minimal|low|medium|high|max. context() is retrieval plus token budget, no extra generation unless chat is used.
cost_shape.label: measured

local.evidence: Self-host via honcho start --setup or docker compose (self-hosting.md). LICENSE is AGPL-3.0 in repo LICENSE. Server will not start without an LLM provider. Defaults are openai gpt-5.4-mini and text-embedding-3-small. Ollama/OpenAI-compatible endpoints are supported. Intimate chat can stay on one machine if the operator supplies a local model and accepts AGPL.
local.label: measured

mcp.evidence: Official MCP at https://mcp.honcho.dev and mcp/ package in the repo (mcp.md). Compose includes an mcp service on port 3000.
mcp.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: Closest engine in this slice. Peers, directional representations, scopes, dialectic chat, and peer cards can model a user and a character. Default product and published evals still treat memory as user-insight RAG for agents. No silence or poisoning controls. SillyTavern path derives only the user peer. AGPL plus a required LLM vendor or local proxy.

published_eval.name: LoCoMo (also LongMem S, BEAM)
published_eval.claimed_score: 89.9% LoCoMo LLM-as-judge; 90.4% LongMem S (92.6% with Gemini 3 Pro). Haiku alone 83.9% on LoCoMo.
published_eval.what_it_actually_scores: Assistant-chat fact QA over stored conversations (LoCoMo ~16k tokens per dialogue). They use LLM-as-judge, not LoCoMo token F1. Does not score character drift, social silence, joke-as-fact, or poisoned persona overwrite.

open_unknowns: Exact deriver LLM call count and token cost per message on the hosted API versus self-host.
Whether hosted Honcho retains customer chat for model training; not specified in the pages read.
Whether contradiction DocumentLevel is exposed to callers as a first-class API filter.
